Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013160304/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2019-worlds.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Card credits ==
Gunnar Brandén is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the original concept of one card.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card was printed in [[Virtual Set 10]] (2019). The full list of people credited on Virtual cards is at [[Card Credits#Gunnar Brandén|Card Credits]].
